assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and dizziness
a personal history of transient ischemic attack (Z86.73)
Mobile cardiac telemetry, CPT 93229, is ordered
to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity and to optimize rate and rhythm control strategies
The payer denied the claim under reason code PR-204
indicating the requested service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan
